result.brief: 提出统一多模态 tokenizer，将外观、投影 LiDAR 深度与自车运动编码为单一可解码连续潜空间，供驾驶世界-动作模型预测未来并解码。
result.reason: Proposes a unified multimodal tokenizer encoding appearance, LiDAR depth and ego motion into one decodable continuous latent for driving world-action models, directly contributing to tokenizer/latent representation learning.
